query: Which policy shocks or natural experiments (reserve requirement changes, bailouts, liquidity injections, resolution regime changes) most credibly identify the liquidity premium λ separate from default risk?

response.query: Which policy shocks or natural experiments (reserve requirement changes, bailouts, liquidity injections, resolution regime changes) most credibly identify the liquidity premium λ separate from default risk?
response.answer: Liquidity injections and resolution regime changes most credibly identify the liquidity premium separate from default risk. Bailouts and reserve requirement changes are less effective for this purpose.
